description: This file implements functions for outputting styled and formatted text to the console or markdown, including handling of color, decorations, and help text formatting. It manages console initialization, output styling, and markdown formatting for command-line help and output display.

methods.name: OutputString
methods.description: Outputs a styled string to the console or markdown, handling decorations, escaping, and formatting based on environment.

methods.name: PrintSectionHelp
methods.description: Prints a help section header, formatted for markdown or plain text.

methods.name: PrintShortHelp
methods.description: Prints a short help line with optional markdown link or styled text.

methods.name: PrintLongHelp
methods.description: Prints detailed help text with markdown or plain text formatting, including headers and code blocks.
